args.subject: Group Booking Availability for 10 People - June 2024
args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Group Bookings Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am organising a group stay at City Hub Tokyo and would like to enquire about availability for a party of 10 people in June 2024.

Could you please let me know:
- Whether you have availability for 10 guests in June 2024
- Any group rates or packages you offer for groups of this size
- The available room configurations and any booking deadlines or deposit requirements

I would be happy to provide further details on our preferred dates and length of stay once you confirm what is possible.

Thank you for your assistance, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
327-420-4923

final_text:
